Task complete. Summary:

**What I changed** (all inside scope `packages/ui/src/graph/**` + `tests/ui-graph.test.tsx`):

- `layout.ts` — `orderedArchived` now keeps every archived change and orders by numeric change id (from `node.id` or the key's numeric prefix), so undated changes get marks. `graphLayout` places archived marks evenly by index instead of landed time. Added `laneLabelWidth()` that estimates the label column from the longest capability id, the `laneLabelFontSize` (16px), and a `0.62em` glyph factor, flooring at `GRAPH_GEOMETRY.laneLabelWidth`. Active gutter and rejected toggle unchanged.
- `relationships.ts` — reads paths now end at the computed label width.
- `types.ts` — `laneLabelWidth` documented as a minimum, added `laneLabelFontSize`, removed unused `overlapOffset`.
- `format.ts` — hover/focus label reads `landed date <date>` or exactly `landed date not recorded`.
- `GraphCanvas.tsx` / `GraphView.tsx` — SVG desc/doc comment say change-number order. Edge classes were already `graph-edge graph-edge-depends`/`-reads`, drawn after lanes and before marks.
- `tests/ui-graph.test.tsx` — updated the landed-time ordering test to change-number order with an undated/malformed-date change, and added a fixture of two undated changes that depend on each other and read `metrics-and-reporting`, asserting id order, one depends and one reads path with their classes, full lane text, and a widened label column.

**Verification**: `pnpm verify` exits 0; all graph files ≤ 250 lines.
